confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Lisbon price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. The cocktail and wine anchors rest mainly on the local price relationship to beer. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Lisbon's own price level and July tourism demand, with reference to other southern European capitals with similar visitor volumes, such as Porto and Madrid. Restaurant anchors use typical tasca and mid-range pricing. Accommodation anchors reflect summer peak rates.
